pages.text:
Splits creosote into fractions with heat. The taller the column, the more it makes, and the faster.
# Building
A solid 2x2 column exactly 4, 6 or 8 tall, of casings and Tray Level Casings with one controller. The controller and the trays can't be in the top or bottom layer. The controller's display is the front.
# Per 1,000 mB of creosote
- 4 high: 250 Naphtha, 2 Pitch.
- 6 high: 250 Naphtha, 450 Heavy Oil, 1 Pitch.
- 8 high: 250 Naphtha, 300 Light Oil, 300 Heavy Oil, 1 Pitch.
Every batch takes 4,000 HU, and the column must be at 350°C or hotter. It feeds 10, 15 or 20 mB/t by height and holds 40,000 HU per 4 blocks. A Fuel Burner under it heats it through the bottom face.

# Steam stripping
Steam in its steam tank (fed through steam faces) raises the Naphtha yield of every batch, out of the Heavy Oil: Steam +15%, High-Pressure +30%, Superheated +50%. Each batch uses 100 mB.
It stops when a product it makes is full, so pipe them away or turn on auto-eject. Each product has its own face mode.
